content:
Chapter 406 - 406 Return; Yadi Automobile! (1)

Chapter 406 - 406 Return; Yadi Automobile! (1)

406 Return; Yadi Automobile! (1)

Silence.

The entire place was silent.

Dai Jiexi, Zheng Lei, Li Fei, and Wang Haohua were all stunned.

Tang Hua actually took the initiative to greet Lin Fan and Ling Rou.

Moreover, there was a hint of flattery in his tone.

Flattery?

The current head of the Tang family wanted to curry favor with Lin Fan and Ling Rou?

This…

This…

What was going on?

Lin Fan nodded at Tang Hua and Ni Min and said, “You guys are here?”

After a pause, he pointed at Dai Jiexi and said, “You know this sinister woman?”

“Sister Ni Min, Mr. Tang, don’t listen to his nonsense…” Dai Jiexi’s heart skipped a beat.

“Nonsense?” Lin Fan said. “Just because Ling Rou walked in front of you on the red carpet, you deliberately knocked her down. Then, you pretended to help her up, but in reality, you just wanted to threaten her.”

“Sister Ni Min, I’m your cousin. You have to believe me!” Dai Jiexi panicked.

As she spoke, she was about to hug Ni Min’s arm.

Ni Min pushed Dai Jiexi away and said coldly, “Do I look like a fool?

“In addition, I’m warning you. From now on, don’t rely on the fact that we’re cousins or say that we know each other to swindle people outside!

“Otherwise, you’ll have to bear the consequences!”

Ni Min hated people who played tricks on her the most.

As for their relationship as cousins, Ni Min directly threw it aside.

It was because she and Dai Jiexi could barely be considered cousins.

In fact, they were relatives.

Before Ni Min became a superstar, the two of them had never met.

Ni Min knew very well that Dai Jiexi only wanted to borrow her power.

However, she did not care too much about it.

It was because helping Dai Jiexi was just a small matter for Ni Min.

It was not a big deal to help someone who could barely be considered an acquaintance.

Now, however, this person who often borrowed her influence was using her to deal with the old man’s savior, a national treasure…

She was simply detestable!

How despicable!

As Ni Min’s voice fell, Dai Jiexi’s heart suddenly froze. She was in utter despair!

It was over!

She knew that she was completely finished!

Compared to Dai Jiexi’s despair, Li Fei and Wang Haohua were filled with joy and excitement.

Even Tang Hua and Ni Min had to curry favor with their boss!

Good!

That was great!

Lin Fan, Ling Rou, Tang Hua, and Ni Min did not pay attention to the people who had different thoughts.

They walked forward and chatted casually.

After Lin Fan and the others left, Dai Jiexi said in a trembling voice, “Zheng Lei, I… What should we do now?”

“How am I supposed to know?!” Zheng Lei said in annoyance.”

After saying that, he turned around and left.

As a manager, Zheng Lei understood the entertainment industry better than Dai Jiexi. At the same time, he understood the influence of the Tang family better.

Dai Jiexi’s singing and acting skills were average, but because she had some connections with the Tang family, she was able to obtain a large amount of resources and become a popular celebrity.

Now, she had lost the Tang family and even offended them.

In that case, she would soon lose these things just like how she had obtained them previously!

“Zheng Lei, Zheng Lei!”

Dai Jiexi called out a few times and chased after him.

She was careless and fell to the ground. She fell flat on his face.

This scene was witnessed by the crowd not far away. They discussed in low voices and took out their phones to send messages.

…

As the lively music played, two hosts who were dressed elegantly walked onto the stage.

They talked about the development, influence, and meaning of music.

Their tone was impassioned, but at the same time, it was humorous, causing the crowd to cheer.

In addition, there were some song and dance performances in between, making the atmosphere extremely lively.

At this moment, the male host in a black suit said, “Next, we will proceed with the most exciting award ceremony!”

In the audience, the nominated singers all became solemn, feeling extremely nervous and expectant.

Among them included Ling Rou and Dai Jiexi, whose face was still red and swollen.

Lin Fan patted Ling Rou’s fair hand and said, “Don’t worry, there won’t be a problem.”

“Yes, yes!” Ling Rou nodded vigorously.

The male host exclaimed, “The winner of this year’s Golden Melody Newcomer Award is… Ling Rou!”

The sound system immediately started playing exciting music.

At the same time, everyone applauded enthusiastically.

Ling Rou was so happy that she was stunned.

She won an award!

She really won the Golden Melody Newcomer Award!

Lin Fan smiled. “Silly girl, what are you waiting for? Hurry up and go on stage.”

When Ling Rou heard his voice, she came back to her senses. She nodded vigorously and walked towards the stage.

A dazzling light shone on Ling Rou.

Ling Rou was already very beautiful, and she had dressed up meticulously today.

Now, under the illumination of the stage lights, her entire body became crystal clear. She was slender and beautiful. Everyone was mesmerized by her.

The male host could not help but say, “Oh my god, she’s so beautiful!”

“She’s definitely the most beautiful woman I’ve ever seen!”

After a pause, the female host continued, “Of course, Ling Rou isn’t just beautiful. Her songs are even more beautiful!

“I’ll never forget the grand concert in Jiangbei a few months ago. I’ll never forget the elegant and free Sword Dance, and I’ll never forget the long and crisp The World of Man… Of course, there’s also her best and most enjoyable song, Galaxy!”
